chapter: New York arrival, Billy Hicks and the Black Cat
title: Bass influences Kirby, Taylor and Blanton
summary: Hall names Kirby and Taylor as influences and describes hearing Jimmy Blanton and Count Basie's first New York visit.

bands.name: Billy Hicks and His Sizzling Six

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, of course, by this time I mean '38, '39 you were hearing, you had met everyone in New York, you were hearing all kinds of things. To you, what was the influence in music so far as bass players.
Well, my influence was already John Kirby and Billy Taylor.
What happened when you heard Blanton?
Oh, fantastic. The takeoff. I was on the bandstand with Billy Hicks when Count Basie came into New York.
